summary: ADR-003 resolves all active product-boundary questions: self-hosted public distribution only, retired demo/OAuth/tester surfaces, and non-distributed private Operator Railway infrastructure.

decisions.rationale: ADR-003 retires the public hosted-demo product surface; no active demo production code, configuration, tests, or public access claim remains.
ADR-003 retires OAuth, dynamic client registration, invites, and Operator/Tester roles; WI-00047 and WI-00057 are terminal superseded/cancelled.
The remaining Railway service is private Operator infrastructure protected by static Bearer authentication and is not distributed as a product endpoint.
The only public product is the MIT self-hosted MCP distributed through GitHub, PyPI, and GHCR; each user installs and operates their own server.
